breakdown.description: Preamble states two incompatible interpretations of Nx and dx (interval-based vs point-based).
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the conflicting instructions regarding the grid definition in the preamble. The ground truth resolves this by removing the incorrect override. The agent achieved the same outcome by omitting the entire confusing preamble and only stating the correct, specific instructions for the periodic grid as defined in the 'Numerical method requirements' section: 'Use a uniform periodic spatial grid with Nx=1024 points on [0,1). Calculate dx as 1/Nx. The grid points are x_j = j*dx for j=0,...,Nx-1.'
